Timeseries data were processed using tools from FSL (Functional MRI of the Brain (FMRIB) Software Library, www.fmrib.ox.ac.uk/fsl ), FreeSurfer ( http://surfer.nmr.mgh.harvard.edu/ ), and AFNI (Analysis of Functional NeuroImages, http://afni.nimh.nih.gov/afni ).

The following preprocessing steps were applied to the functional data: simultaneous application of fieldmap-based EPI unwarping (FUGUE) ( 31 , 32 ) and motion correction (MCFLIRT) ( 33 ); bias-field correction (FAST) ( 34 ); removal of spike artifacts with 3dDespike; correction for slice timing differences using Fourier space-time shifting implemented in slicetimer; mask-based removal of non-brain tissue; spatial smoothing with SUSAN with FWHM=5mm; grand-mean intensity normalization by a single multiplicative factor; high-pass temporal filtering of 90 seconds.
spatial smoothing with SUSAN with FWHM=5mm

description.value: Functional MRI time series were processed with FSL, FreeSurfer, and AFNI. The pipeline included fieldmap-based EPI unwarping, motion correction, bias-field correction, despiking, slice-timing correction, non-brain masking, 5-mm FWHM spatial smoothing, grand-mean intensity normalization, and 90-second high-pass temporal filtering, followed by registration to the participant's structural image and Montreal Neurological Institute template space.

spans.text: The following preprocessing steps were applied to the functional data: simultaneous application of fieldmap-based EPI unwarping (FUGUE) ( 31 , 32 ) and motion correction (MCFLIRT) ( 33 ); bias-field correction (FAST) ( 34 ); removal of spike artifacts with 3dDespike; correction for slice timing differences using Fourier space-time shifting implemented in slicetimer; mask-based removal of non-brain tissue; spatial smoothing with SUSAN with FWHM=5mm; grand-mean intensity normalization by a single multiplicative factor; high-pass temporal filtering of 90 seconds.
